name: Raul Valle
tagline: Machine learning for physical and neural systems.
shortBio: Raul Valle is a University of Florida Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering building machine learning for physical and neural systems: surrogate models for computational fluid dynamics, neural-imaging analysis, and research software.
longBio: Raul Valle is a Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Florida. He builds machine-learning surrogate models for computational fluid dynamics in the SmartDATA Lab, and his neuroengineering work in the Computational NeuroEngineering Lab spans event detection and source separation for neural imaging, state-space modeling, and time-series experiment infrastructure.
